mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST rises over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction signal < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
